messages.subject: dplyr + ggvis + shiny 應用
parts:
近日有網友提及以下問題:

dplyr + ggvis + shiny 應用中, 如何使用下拉式選單, 建立互動式shiny應用, 參考以下修改後程式碼如下:

1. 原資料集含有 [Tab] 符號, 先行取代為空白 gsub("\\t", "", test$States)
2.原資料集含有空白字元" ", 先取代為 "" test$States <- trimws(test$States)
3. ym 物件應無功能, 先 #
3. 加入 filter(States == input$bg_states) %>% 以利產生互動效果



library(shiny)
library(ggvis)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
test <- read.csv("1995.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
test
test$States <- gsub("\\t", "", test$States)
test$States <- trimws(test$States)

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      
      selectInput("bg_states", label = h3("region:"),c("TaipeiCity","NewTaipeiCity"))
      
    ),
    mainPanel(
      h3("Man and woman age stack bar graph"),
      ggvisOutput("mytest")
    )
  )
  
))

server <- shinyServer(function(input,output){
  
  mytest <- reactive({
    
    #ym <- unique(as.character(input$bg_states))
    
    test %>%
      filter(States == input$bg_states) %>%
      group_by(age, type) %>%
      summarise(population = sum(population)) %>%
      ggvis(~age, ~population) %>%
      layer_bars(fill = ~type, width = 0.5)
  })
  
  mytest %>% bind_shiny("mytest")
  
})
shinyApp(ui,server)
